entry_rationale: Sidecar has zero open positions. Deploy $50m of the $100m gross cap into the primary hawkish expression: long implied-rate SOFR_2027-09 at the packet mid of 4.755%. Size is half the book because the 25bp hike was already >90% priced, 2Y has already backed up 57bp in 1m, and SR3 positioning is unknown; still large enough that expected terminal repricing can clear the 3.85% SOFR funding vig that is charged whether flat or deployed.
entry_thesis: Underpriced US terminal: SR3U7 at 4.755% prices a finished-enough hiking cycle; inflation persistence and a live global tightening impulse should push 2027 implied rates higher.
